title: Publishing video game to steam I made from using Sonnet 5.5 only took about 4 hours.
author: Froggerbotrom
selftext:
you start at a folding table in a basement and you win your way out, one table at a time, through 21 chapters on the road to Las Vegas. Every chapter is a different room with its own house rule, its own regulars, its own music, and a boss who runs the table and lets you know it before the first card is dealt.

The rooms get weird fast: a backyard BBQ, a 1903 circus tent, a speakeasy, a haunted mansion, a backwoods farmhouse where the rocking chair moves by itself, an underwater dome, a space station, and a 1987 trading floor where a brass bell rings every time someone goes all in.

**Losing is half the fun.** Every room has its own bust scene. You walk the plank on the pirate ship. The vaudeville hook yanks you off stage at the circus. A seagull steals your last chip in Atlantic City. The ghost chases you out of the mansion. Knock out a boss and *they* get the treatment instead.

**The characters:** 59 oddballs, including a vampire countess, a mummy, a ringmaster, a strongman, a 1980s stockbroker in red suspenders, and a cat who bluffs way too much. They sit at the table, sip their drinks, tip their hats when they win, and needle each other by name, with about 1,000 lines of table talk in all. You can unlock and play as any of them.

**It's real poker under the hood:** full No-Limit Hold'em with side pots and opponents who adjust to how you play, plus house rules like turbo blinds, deep stacks, antes, bounties, all-in-or-fold and heads-up showdowns.

**Also in there:**

* Private online tables with friends over Steam or your home Wi-Fi
* 300+ things to collect: card decks, gold bullion chips, nameplates, charms, victory celebrations
* Loot chests as you level up
* An original chiptune soundtrack
* Six languages
* Runs natively on Steam Deck
* Play money only: no real-money gambling and nothing to buy with real cash

The Steam page is coming soon. In the meantime:

Any ideas you guys can think of for this?

  
Has tons of content right now

comments.body: It sounds like a lot of fun no suggestions just best of luck. Crazy that all took such little time.

I had only two hiccups with a glitch with the one graphic light in the one level and the last hand even if you win you can muck the cards at the showdown which is not correct. 

It is insane. The steam deck version runs amazing too

Sounds at least like you had fun making it.
